name: Fireburst, Greater
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level bloodrager 4, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

EFFECT

Range 15 ft.

This spell functions as lesser fireburst except it has a wider burst radius and deals 1d10 fire damage per caster level (maximum 15d10).
